reviewers.Codex: Selects Returning for stable complete silhouette, native safe framing and consistent wide composition.
reviewers.Grok w1:p7: Prefers Turning (02) for the more animated pose, shell depth and stronger red point; considers Returning strongest in compact small-size balance. This recommendation was read and retained, not described as unanimous approval.
reviewers.Pi w1:p8: Read-only integration review identified native SVG assumptions and recommended family plus versioned brand-kit delivery.

selectionRationale: Returning passes the 128px rounded-outline clearance requirement at native size without reframing; Turning would need additional inset or another generation.
64/48/32/24/16px complete-frame comparisons favor the stable low Returning silhouette for repeated small navigation uses.
Hero 04 preserves the chosen identity in a separately generated 5:2 composition, with a quiet spiral paper field.
history: All six requests, responses, prompts, untouched PNGs and reviews retained; unselected concepts are not published as the current brand.
